text:
maria: heads up — canary for route /generate with tenant t-42 hit a fallthrough today. pinned alias -> rwd-qa-3; runtime returned incompatible-schema error and gateway fell back to rwd-small-v1. user-facing responses degraded. need a plan for better audit + console UX for these flows

kevin: ugh. do we have telemetry that records both the pin decision and the actual model served? that trace would make root-cause obvious.

maria: short answer: we log decision_trace but it's terse. we don't persist the policy version or the alias metadata in the same event. ops had to stitch logs together.

jamal: proposal: a single routing_event that contains: matched_rule_id, rule_version, requested_alias (if any), alias_constraints (compatibility tags), chosen_model, fallback_reason, latency_ms, sample_input_id. store at INFO and index by tenant+route. sampling for payloads.

sasha: love that. console UX asks for two things: 1) timeline view for rollouts that highlights when fallbacks happened, 2) a readable diff of rule changes that includes capability constraints (e.g., "requires_kv_cache: true", "max_seq_len: 4096").

kevin: regarding fallback_reason — enumerate reasons: capacity, compatibility-mismatch, auth/quotas, runtime-error. compatibility-mismatch needs structured fields: incompatible_field (kv_cache, seq_len, quant_profile), required, served_capability.

maria: +1. also we should capture the header negotiation inputs. for example the gateway should store which headers matched the rule: `x-redwood-model`, `x-tenant-pref`, `x-model-version`. small snippet:```
MatchedHeaders: { x-redwood-model: "rwd-qa-3", x-client-seq: "600" }
```

jamal: implementation note: gateway decides quick fallbacks synchronously. control plane should asynchronously reconcile and emit a reconciliation_event when a pin is stale or violates constraints. that event can trigger console alerts and automated rollback candidates.

ops-bot: FYI — quota backpressure often causes fallback to lower-tier models. we need to correlate quota_evaluation_id in events.

kevin: telemetry detail: add a boolean `fallback_forbidden_by_policy` to indicate rule prohibits fallback (hard pin). that drives alerting. if hard pin and fallback occurred, page SRE immediately.

sasha: UI toggle: show "soft pin" vs "hard pin" in rule editor. soft pins should surface an explicit fallback policy chooser (e.g., fallback_aliases, fallback_max_latency_ms).

maria: what about audit trails? compliance wants immutable record for any change that caused a tenant to serve a different model than the pinned alias. we can snapshot the resolved model metadata (commit sha, quant profile) at the time of serving and keep a hash pointer in the routing_event.

jamal: agree. store minimal snapshot: model_id, build_sha, quant_profile, capability_tags. payloads redacted but keep hash + sampling s3 path.

kevin: ops QA ask: can we expose a query in console: "show all fallbacks in last 24h where compatibility-mismatch=true and tenant=t-42". should be trivial if we standardize event schema.

maria: final UX ask: when creating/editing a rule in console, validate rule against a set of test prompts (short suite) and show predicted routing outcome with reasons. that would catch obvious incompat pins ahead of rollout.

sasha: +1 — also render guidance: "This alias requires kv-cache; consider enabling prefix_cache on route or choose alias rwd-qa-3-kv-enabled". small helper links to model compatibility docs.

kevin: action items: jamal to draft event schema + reconciliation_event, sasha to prototype rollout timeline UI with embedded events, maria to coordinate sampling policy and retention, i'll add alerting rules for hard-pin fallback. ops-bot: can you attach quota correlation links to routing_event?

ops-bot: will do — adding quota_evaluation_id & quota_snapshot_url to event schema.

deploy-bot: canary 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z deployed to gateway v3.4.7 (routing quick-fallback enabled) :rocket:

maria: thanks team. aim to have schema PR by EOD tomorrow so we can start piping to ES and iterate on console mocks.

kevin: thanks — i'll review the PR and wire up alerting rules if schema looks good.

jamal: drafting now, will drop link when ready.

sasha: mockups incoming later today.

maria: marking this thread for follow-up in the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
